data.name: Tiphany
data.gender_notes: Tiphany is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'tiphainos' meaning 'godly, divine, beautiful'. The name Tiphany symbolizes the divine grace and beauty bestowed upon an individual by God. The name Tiphany carries the meaning “God's grace, beauty” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Tiphany usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace, beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Divine grace, beauty in one's soul
data.etymology: Tiphany belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's grace, beauty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tiphany total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Tiphany holds a rich cultural heritage, as it is not a commonly used Christian name. It adds an element of exclusivity and uniqueness to the individual bearing this name. Its origin from the Greek language adds to its exotic allure.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Tiphany holds deep spiritual significance as it is a reminder of the divine grace and beauty bestowed upon each individual by God. It encourages individuals to strive towards godliness, divinity, and beauty in their actions and character. The name Tiphany is a constant reminder of the ultimate source of grace and beauty, and inspires one to live a life that reflects that divinity.
